lines.text: This is Tidepool, a notes app that keeps everything on your own device. Let's capture a note from start to finish.
lines.source_text: This is Tidepool, a notes app that keeps everything on your own device. Let's capture a note from start to finish.

lines.text: To start a note, press N. The New note button does the same thing.
lines.source_text: To start a note, press N. The New note button does the same thing.

lines.text: The cursor is already in the title, so just type.
lines.source_text: The cursor is already in the title, so just type.

lines.text: Press Enter to jump down to the body.
lines.source_text: Press Enter to jump down to the body.

lines.text: The body is Markdown. A dash and two brackets make a checklist item.
lines.source_text: The body is Markdown. A dash and two brackets make a checklist item.

lines.text: Press Enter, and the list carries on by itself.
lines.source_text: Press Enter, and the list carries on by itself.

lines.text: In split view, the preview on the right renders it as you type.
lines.source_text: In split view, the preview on the right renders it as you type.

lines.text: Command E flips to the full preview. Press it again to keep writing.
lines.source_text: Command E flips to the full preview. Press it again to keep writing.

lines.text: Tags go under the title. Click Add tag, type planning, and press Enter.
lines.source_text: Tags go under the title. Click Add tag, type planning, and press Enter.

lines.text: Then choose a notebook. This one belongs in Work.
lines.source_text: Then choose a notebook. This one belongs in Work.

lines.text: There's no save button. Tidepool saves as you type, and nothing leaves this device.
lines.source_text: There's no save button. Tidepool saves as you type, and nothing leaves this device.

lines.text: The sidebar says so too: sync is set to local only.
lines.source_text: The sidebar says so too: sync is set to local only.

lines.text: Press Escape to leave the editor, then P to pin the note to the top.
lines.source_text: Press Escape to leave the editor, then P to pin the note to the top.

lines.text: Pinned notes stay above everything else, marked with a small pin.
lines.source_text: Pinned notes stay above everything else, marked with a small pin.

lines.text: That's the whole loop. Press N, type, and Tidepool keeps it.
lines.source_text: That's the whole loop. Press N, type, and Tidepool keeps it.

lines.text: Next time: finding any note in a second.
